title: Force needed for a prescribed joint displacement of a two-bar truss

source.work: McGuire, W., Gallagher, R. H., Ziemian, R. D., Matrix Structural Analysis
source.notes: input data and targets read on the cited pages; nothing of the source is reproduced

analysis: Pin-jointed plane truss in the x-y plane (global Y vertical): members of type 'truss'; the out-of-plane translation of every joint is held by a support (it has no stiffness in a plane truss). Joint a at the origin, pinned supports b (2, 2) m and c (-4, 2) m (printed dimensions 4 m, 2 m, 2 m). A_ab = 1000 mm^2, A_ac = 4000 mm^2, E = 200,000 MPa. Joint a is moved 5 mm vertically downward with no horizontal displacement: modelled as a support at a (ux, uy) with the imposed displacement uy = -5 mm; the force the source asks for is the reaction of that support. First order.

targets.precisionNote: printed "181.0"; tolerance = half a unit in the last printed digit
targets.sign: the source's required force P on joint a = the engine's reaction at a (force on the structure)
